ycoss:11922.long_description: Trexo Robotics is building exoskeletons to help people walk, starting with children. Our product allows children with disabilities like Cerebral Palsy, to walk, in many cases for the first time in their lives. Trexo was started when Manmeet found that his nephew was born with Cerebral Palsy and would never be able to walk. Trexo is selling commercially, with a vision is to replace the wheelchair, for children, adults, and the elderly.
ycoss:11922.metadata_document: Trexo Robotics is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Winter 2019 batch, in 2019. Its status is active. Its stage is early. Y Combinator lists its industry as Healthcare. Its sub-industry is Healthcare within Medical Devices. Additional listed industries: Medical Devices. Y Combinator source tags: Medical Robotics. It is located in Toronto, ON, Canada. Listed regions: Canada, America / Canada, Remote, Partly Remote. Its team size is 30. It launched in 2018.
